verdict.rationale: SAM.gov publishes a system-to-system channel on one public page. It covers System Accounts, created through the "System Accounts" widget and then approved, plus API keys tied to SAM.gov accounts. It also documents rate limits, a bulk API Extract and data tiers set by the account's sensitivity level, so software can transact with the service through a published enrollment route. missing for 10: details of the system-account approval process (criteria, timeline, who approves), independent or hands-on corroboration that enrollment works as documented.
